modelNotes: Points Board 1.4 reads from core, minutes, usage, opponent team defense, and opponent pace data.
Opponent points defense and pace apply a transparent adjustment capped at plus or minus 6 percent.
Expected minutes, rest, verified teammate absences, and recent-game volatility produce opportunity adjustments and projection ranges.

Foundation uses scoring average, last 5 form, last 10 form, enhanced expected minutes, minutes confidence, minutes trend, usage score, usage trend, volume acceleration, shot volume trend, free throw volume trend, and starter status.
No odds or betting lines are used.

injury.shortComment: Sabonis has been downgraded to questionable for Sunday's game against Miami due to left knee soreness.
injury.detail: Sabonis was a late addition to the injury report and could miss his first game of the season. If the veteran center joins Maxime Raynaud (knee) on the inactive list, Dylan Cardwell and Precious Achiuwa would be candidates for increased playing time.

injury.shortComment: Robinson (illness) is questionable for Sunday's game versus Milwaukee, Bobby Krivitsky of Forbes.com reports.
injury.detail: Robinson isn't feeling well, so he may not be available against the Bucks, which would mark his second absence of the 2026-27 campaign. If Robinson can't suit up, it should mean more minutes for Luka Garza behind Neemias Queta.

injury.shortComment: Trent (illness) has been downgraded to questionable for Sunday's game against Boston.
injury.detail: Trent was a late addition to the injury report due to an illness. The veteran wing has totaled 13 minutes over two regular-season appearances, so his potential absence wouldn't impact the rotation.
